name: card_ap_formula_mythril
description: AP formula mythril floor (docs/card-ap-cost-formula.md §3.4/§4.1): a real deck of five mythril bows (power 7 + mythril premium = 5 AP) dealt through deck_init draws pip tile 122 (AP_TILE_5) on all five hand slots. Pips draw regardless of affordability, so the pool is fine; the 5 staged arrows back the full draw (never-draw-empty would otherwise leave slots empty).
